backend/main.mo: Defines data types for tailoring app, static catalog data, and a date comparison helper for orders.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features with related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short descriptions of each frontend file for reference and build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind setup with custom design tokens, theme variables, and dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wiring sections, contact bar, header, and intersection observer for active navigation.
frontend/src/components/branding/LogoPla: Simple placeholder logo component displaying a scissors icon.
frontend/src/components/catalog/CatalogS: Catalog viewer with category filtering, loading/error states, and style selection that scrolls to the order form.
frontend/src/components/layout/Section.t: Reusable section wrapper applying consistent padding, layout, and background variants.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Renders the site footer with brand info, quick-scroll links, contact details, and a credits link.
frontend/src/components/navigation/SiteH: Provides a sticky header with logo, navigation links, scroll behavior, and a mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/navigation/TopCo: Displays a top bar showing clickable phone and email contact details.
frontend/src/components/order/OrderNowSe: Implements an order form with validation, measurement inputs, style selection, and order submission.
frontend/src/components/order/SizeGuideP: Provides a collapsible panel containing measurement instructions and a size reference table.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Shows an about section with tailoring features and a descriptive overview of the business.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Displays contact information and a validated inquiry form with submission handling.
frontend/src/components/sections/HomeHer: Hero section with background images, promotional text, and buttons that smooth-scroll to order and catalog sections.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Exports static contact information for phone, email, address, and business name.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, handling auth client creation, login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching catalog data and submitting orders or inquiries through the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind and font setup with custom OKLCH color variables and theming rules for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that mounts React with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/state/selectedStyle.ts: Zustand store holding the currently selected style for ordering.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radii, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining scope, requirements, architectural notes, and existing implemented features.
